ideas.pitch: A multilingual local dialect AI health assistant tailored for rural health workers in Assam to assess symptoms and check vaccine schedules offline-first.
ideas.title: Assam Rural Health Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the real-world impact evaluation criteria emphasised by ADTU judges by addressing regional healthcare access in Assam using proven multilingual patterns.

ideas.pitch: A GIS-enabled real-time flood risk mapping tool that aggregates local sensor feeds and crowdsourced inputs to generate safe evacuation routes for rural communities.
ideas.title: Brahmaputra Flood Early Warning & Evacuation Map
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high technical feasibility and immediate local relevance to Guwahati and Assam, scoring well on the practical problem-solving rubric.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile web tool that grades tea leaves by quality and detects early blight disease using smartphone camera imagery.
ideas.title: Smart Tea Leaf Grading System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages computer vision for a dominant regional industry in Assam, providing clear economic benefit and high novelty for university judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-commission hyperlocal e-commerce platform for Assamese handicraft makers featuring instant voice-to-text product listing in local languages.
ideas.title: Local Artisan Direct Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical social impact with a working demo that solves local economic hurdles, satisfying the 25% proposed solution criterion.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and dashboard solution monitoring campus electricity and smart bin fill levels to optimise university utility costs and waste collection routes.
ideas.title: Campus Energy & Waste Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applicable to the host institution (ADTU campus), giving evaluators an immediate tangible use case with measurable cost savings.
